$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is the site id at the start of a case's title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The findings follow the right answers in demo-retailer/SCENARIOS.md. Rowanmere Group, its restaurants and their readings are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

replies.R-014:
Summary
Restaurant R-014, Rowanmere Kitchen Harbour Street, Port Ilvane.
Period: October 2026.
31 days of records and 9 deliveries.

Draft findings. For review by the food safety lead. Not signed.

| # | Check | Plan reference and limit | What the records show | Dates | Mark | Food safety lead should check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Make-line chiller | Section 2.1: 1.0 °C to 5.0 °C | Three readings above 5.0 °C: 6.8, 7.4 and 6.1 | 8 Oct afternoon, 9 Oct opening, 21 Oct afternoon | repeated deviation | Section 6.2 applies: the food safety lead decides whether the unit stays in use until it is serviced |
| 2 | Hot holding cabinet | Section 3.2: 63.0 °C or hotter | Two readings below 63.0 °C: 58.5 and 60.2 | 14 Oct 16:00, 27 Oct 18:00 | outside the limit | What was done with the food held at those times |
| 3 | Daily cleaning sign-off | Section 5.1: one signed entry for each trading day | Three days with no signed entry | 5, 17 and 26 Oct | missing entry | Whether the cleaning was done and not signed, or not done |
| 4 | All other checks | Sections 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 4.1 and 4.2 | Walk-in chiller, freezer, chicken core temperature and nine deliveries: no deviation | 1 to 31 Oct | within the plan | Nothing further |

Proposed next step: refer to the food safety lead under section 6.2: the make-line chiller, three readings outside the limit in the month. Corrective actions still to be recorded: (1) the three make-line chiller readings; (2) the two hot holding readings; (3) the three days with no cleaning sign-off.
